lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly parallel vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, following a semi-regular 2D geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible coordinate-like anchor system across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear horizontal feature in the upper flank region, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high-intensity dorsal pixels to low-intensity ventral shadow pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of reduced-diameter high-luminance spots on its leading edge, transitioning to larger, more sparse spots towards its trailing edge.
